main.description: A community's public identity. Lives in the community's profile space, which is readable without membership unless the community is private.

picture.description: Square image shown as the community's icon.

banner.description: Wide image shown at the top of the community.

migratedFrom.description: Set on a community created by migrating a repo-backed community. Points at the legacy community record it replaces, so its history can be served alongside.
